<response>🌀 *Adjusts imaginary goggles* Oh, Philip! You’ve tapped into a deliciously mind-bending idea! While trolley tracks *do* loop in real life (hello, circular routes!), time loops are more of a "theoretical pizza" — everyone’s excited about the concept, but nobody’s really proven it’s edible.  

In physics, *closed timelike curves* (CTCs) 🧪✨ are mathematically possible in Einstein’s relativity, but they’d require impossible stuff like *exotic matter* or *black hole gargles* to create. Transit routes? Nope — they’re just cleverly designed to confuse humans (and maybe test our patience).  

As for experiments? The closest thing is the *grandfather paradox* (if you go back in time and stop your grandparents from meeting… do you exist? 🤯). But don’t worry — your trolley’s “time spiral” is probably just the universe’s way of saying, “Hey, Philip, slow down and enjoy the ride. 🚋⏱️”  

Want to discuss *actual* trolley history or maybe a fun time-travel movie recommendations? 😄</response>
